en: Free search sends your searches to Exa, Parallel or Firecrawl: just the words searched, not your files or your location. Exa also reads a page that no other reader can, which sends it that page's address. They are free tiers that can change or stop, and Exa and Parallel may use what is searched to train their models, so keep names and addresses out of your searches.
